variants.name: Barrikada
variants.info: Changes your shot load to Barrikada. Known as 'Barricade' in English, fire a large solid steel projectile much like a slug with the capabilities of destroying a cars engine block at up to 100 meters. Increased projectile speed with high damage to the head at range. Incredible penetration potential.

variants.name: Harpoon
variants.info:
Muzzle load a harpoon into your KS-23M.
 Ignoring the lack of the rope typically attached, this uses an overpressured blank shell to propel the harpoon way over yonder!

variants.name: Volna-R
variants.info: Changes your shot load to Volna-R. Known as 'Wave' in English, fire a single large rubber slug used for less than lethal purposes. But less than lethal is still lethal, and a large 23mm rubber ball is about to prove that with incredibly high damage to the body and limbs, but the actual rubber slug itself travels slowly.

variants.name: 4 Gauge
variants.info:
An incredibly large shotgun shell typically used for shooting waterfowl or big game in long range. Typically sold in the civilian market. Almost guaranteed to take multiple targets in a single shot!
Contains a large wide-spread amount of pellets with higher penetration with reduced damage, but powerful enough to annihilate anything in your path!
Takes extra time and care to rechamber!

variants.name: Shrapnel-25
variants.info: Changes your shot load to Shrapnel-25. Saboted 23mm shells designed to keep the buckshot close to the center of the barrel making shots at range much easier to hit consistently. Reduces spread dramatically but lowers individual pellet damage.
